review.utf16_probe: Normalized nonnegative candidate, positive count <=128, both physical character ends checked; byte offsets and twice-count fit arrays. A rejected candidate is skipped once; from=0 misses terminate. Raw byte equality preserves UTF-16 code units and surrogate behavior.
review.reverse_filter: Probe offset is a checked mismatch within count. Blocks cover candidate probe positions [probe, from+probe+1). Empty blocks cannot contain a match; scalar continuation includes every earlier candidate.
review.word_scans: Length >=288 proves complete eight-byte loads over the compiled prefix; endpoints retain original handling. Interpreter uses the scalar probe. Reverse indices remain exclusive. Latin1 masks preserve Java whitespace and CR/LF rules.
review.line_words: Snapshot the byte-array reference and check complete [start,fence) before Unsafe word reads. The admission bound proves start+64 <= fence, including split spliterator ranges.
review.dispatch: Native entry wrappers are outlined while normalized short Java loops remain inline. Physical guards precede Unsafe/native operations. Native kernel code and bounded-window/safepoint policy are unchanged.
